plane_notes.source: product output *OK.py (LOWER BOUND proxy: the product can drop forms - see ATTACK_L4_RUNTIME B202/B203/B208 - but does not invent them)
plane_notes.source_original: original .py: 5/402 files exist but all are 0-byte placeholders; effective availability = 0/402

plane_limits.match_stmt: literal-only `case` patterns compile to COMPARE_OP/POP_JUMP without any MATCH_* opcode -> bytecode sees only structural patterns (sequence/mapping/class); literal cases invisible
plane_limits.ifexp: ternary and if-statement share the same bytecode shape -> not decidable
plane_limits.chain_compare: chained comparison shares JUMP_IF_FALSE_OR_POP with BoolOp -> only separable heuristically (previous opcode != COMPARE_OP)
plane_limits.pep604_union: PEP 604 `X | Y` is a plain NB_OR on type objects -> not decidable
plane_limits.annotation: MAKE_FUNCTION flag 0x04 / SETUP_ANNOTATIONS only cover function+class+module annotations; local variable annotations are not evaluated at runtime -> invisible
plane_limits.del_stmt: DELETE_* opcodes also emitted by the compiler for except* handler variable cleanup -> bytecode over-counts user `del`
plane_limits.walrus: the walrus compiles to `COPY 1` + STORE, which is also used to copy a closure cell -> the bytecode detector excludes the LOAD_CLOSURE+COPY shape, but a `COPY 1` before a STORE inside a match subject is still ambiguous
plane_limits.boolop_chain: bytecode sees only value-position short-circuits (JUMP_IF_*_OR_POP); a BoolOp in test position compiles to POP_JUMP_IF_FALSE and is indistinguishable from a plain if -> bytecode under-counts (use the source plane)
plane_limits.nonlocal_stmt: `nonlocal x` compiles exactly like a closure capture (cell var) -> bytecode-invisible; source plane only
